question: In the US, which kills the most birds each year: wind turbines, cars, windows, or pet and stray cats?
answer: Cats, by a wide margin: about 2.4 billion birds a year, Loss and colleagues estimated, most killed by strays and ferals but many by pets. Windows come next at about 600 million. Wind turbines, often blamed, killed about 234,000 a year when counted, roughly one bird for every 10,000 taken by cats.
move: Blame falls on what is new and visible; old, familiar culprits go unnoticed.
reference: Loss, Will & Marra (2013) The impact of free-ranging domestic cats on wildlife of the United States, Nature Communications 4: 1396; Loss et al. (2014) The Condor 116: 8-23; Loss et al. (2014) Journal of Wildlife Management 78: 763-771; Loss, Will & Marra (2013) Biological Conservation 168: 201-209
ask: Does my cat, or my neighbour's, hunt outdoors, and what does it bring home?

items.label: Wind turbines
items.note: About 234,000: one bird for every 10,000 that cats kill.

items.label: Windows
items.note: About 600 million, mostly at houses and low buildings, not skyscrapers.

items.label: Cats
items.note: About 2.4 billion, mostly by strays and ferals, but pet cats too.

items.label: Cars
items.note: About 200 million, though estimates run from 89 to 340 million.
